perks.name: Hungry Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.desc: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Honed Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.desc: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Tempered Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage and ammo.

perks.name: Balanced Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.

perks.name: Burst Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.

perks.name: Enduring Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

perks.name: Swordmaster's Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.desc: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Eager Edge
perks.desc: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Cold Steel
perks.desc: Powered Sword hits slow targets.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Permeability
perks.desc: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.desc: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.
